results.title: 92nd annual meeting of Indian Academy of Sciences to begin at NCESS on November 13
results.content: The meeting brings together eminent scientists, researchers and academicians from across India

results.title: Two killed, six injured as dumper hits autorickshaw in Delhi’s Sonia Vihar; pregnant woman suffers miscarriage
results.content: A six-month-old girl was among those injured in the early-morning accident in north-east Delhi; the dumper driver fled the spot

results.title: Norwegian journalist Helle Lyng says she has been stopped from coming to Hyderabad for Bharat Summit
results.content: Ms. Lyng says she has been denied entry into India despite having a visa; The Hindu has access to Ms. Lyng’s documents, which show a visa was first granted and revoked later
